test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 26 Sept 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Under Abdul Kalam Technology Innovation National Fellowship funded by the Science and Engineering Research Board (SERB), the fellowship amount is _______ per month in addition to regular income research grant of Rs. 15 lakh per annum and an overhead of Rs. 1 lakh per annum.
solution:
The correct answer is** 'Rs. 25,000'**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The fellowship amount is **Rs.** **25,000** per month in addition to regular income. 
 
• A Research grant of Rs. 15.00 lakh per annum
 
• The scheme is applicable to Indian nationals working in India in various capacities of engineering profession in public funded institutions.
 
• **This applicant should have a minimum of five (5) years of service left in the parent organizationas on the date of the award**.
 
• Students can **apply online or by email/post** for this award.
 
• The students up to Class 12 can apply for this Abdul Kalam award. The applicants must not be over the age of 17-18. 
 
• The applicants who have the maximum age limit out of school are 17 years old. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• An Act of Parliament created the **Science and Engineering Research Board (SERB**), a statutory organisation.
 
• The Board's primary and unique mandate is to support basic research in new fields of science and engineering.
 
• The requirements for its** proper implementation** are taken into account while choosing the budget.
 
• Given the infrastructure and resources available at the implementing institutions, the investigator should suggest a budget that is reasonable.
 
• The CRG project has a** three-year length** and an average cost of Rs. 35 lakh.
